issue_context.title: support enable internal check by failpoint
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement
We have created many internal checks(asserts). 
These checks work for UT but don't work for IT. We have many tests run on our internal test platform, and can't benefit from these checks.

we can enable these checks by failpoint
1. Use a failpoint to turn on these checks.
2. Use a failpoint image and enable it in our test plan.

review_comments:
if it's not a `const`, maybe in the compile stage golang can't eliminate the check. I'm not sure how much it will affect performance.

we already have `intest` and `enableassert` build tags, can we make use of these build tags?
It may not be easy to get these images in TCMS if using build tags.
